name: Trap
summary: Dark half-time trap at 130-160 bpm: long 808s, clap on 3, rolling hats and a minor bell loop.
keys: minor (natural or harmonic): C, F, G, A minor

harmony.notes: Two-bar chords (beats_per_chord 8); the bell loop carries the harmony, chords are often implied.

bass.register: 808 roots C1-B1, long notes that follow the kick

sounds.melody: poly_synth: Pluck Lead or sampler: Sine Pluck

mix.notes: 808 and kick never fight: sidechain or shorten the 808 at kicks; saturate the 808 for small speakers; hats bright, panned slightly.

do: Hat rolls and 808 slides as transitions
Mute the 808 for a bar before the hook
dont: Snare on 2 and 4 (it is half time: clap on 3)
